scope.conditions: High quality 1280x720, same 180 s input record; physical dry road for both visual presets. Capture windows start at slightly different route steps because of UI operation. 5 s active warmup plus 150 s capture, fixed resolution. No synthetic comparative speedup claim.
scope.concurrency: No numerical tests, build jobs, other benchmark or inspection render work during either capture. One screenshot and occasional browser AX observation were taken; light text/file review and this chat remained active. Not an exclusive OS benchmark.
scope.limits: Day has 3 frames >250 ms (max 353 ms); night has 4 >250 ms (max 751.1 ms) plus 2 other >50 ms. CPU spikes include scene/shadow and reflection stages; they have not been eliminated or conclusively attributed. First-use shader/driver work remains a hypothesis, not a proved root cause. All long frames are retained. Preparation itself can take tens of seconds after a cold graphics configuration change. No hardware keyboard/gamepad, audio-listening or multi-device certification.
scope.visual: day-route.png and night-route.png are actual moving browser screenshots, different route locations, not pixel-matched before/after pairs. Vehicle inspection is separately recorded.

blockingFinding: After the recorded day/night captures, rapidly changing ultra/wet-night to balanced/clear-day disposed a material program still polled by compileAsync. Browser TypeError reading isReady left preparation pending. These measurements retain their actual precursor build; they do not certify the corrected final build.
